run_GPT_model: run the GPT model forward pass with token indices and optional targets to compute loss
run_Muon_optimizer: run the Muon optimizer step to apply orthogonalized SGD-momentum updates to 2D parameters
build_DistributedDataLoader: build a DistributedDataLoader to load tokenized data shards across multiple GPU processes
run_zeropower_via_newtonschulz5: run the Newton-Schulz iteration to compute the zeroth power orthogonalization of a 2D matrix
run_CausalSelfAttention: run the CausalSelfAttention module forward pass with rotary embeddings and RMS normalization on input tensors
